summary: Banzai International entered a Sept 4, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with an accredited investor for a private placement of a convertible note initially $2,142,857 (up to $3,571,428) plus warrants for 779,221 Class A shares, with additional warrants for 519,480 shares on later tranches. The $1.5M Initial Closing funded; two $1.0M tranches remain. Aegis Capital is exclusive placement agent at 10% fees. The company must seek Nasdaq 20% issuance approval within 60 days. Watch dilution, tranche conditions, and stockholder-vote risk.
